This premature filtering resulted in an empty dataset, causing all subsequent verification and analysis steps to operate on incomplete data, directly leading to the incorrect final count. Had the initial extraction adhered to the full scope, the error would have been caught earlier or not propagated.

Had this step correctly interpreted the task to extract all HTML image tags from the start, the subsequent verification steps would have been testing a complete dataset rather than an incomplete one.
